answer: Reaching the velvet of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Every claim climbs the plume of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the jetty re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
